title: Docs and changelog
purpose: A third of the PRs in this build are specs, docs, prompts, ADRs and memory. Are they true, verifiable, linked and current, so an outdated rule is never mistaken for a live one? The docs-and-spec reviewer (PAP-677) embeds this rubric; PAP-209's library rubric and PAP-130's ADR template are its references.
notCovered: Agent prompt safety and behaviour (agent-behaviour rubric).
Spec validator errors (Gate 1, PAP-115) beyond citing them.
Typos and grammar below S3: praise or ignore.

S0: A runbook step deletes production data without the deny-list warning: following the doc as written is destructive.
S1: An ADR without Alternatives rejected or Consequences.
A `must` in a spec with no check named beside it.
A dangling link to a spec that was renamed.
S2: Style rule violations in a prompt (model names, unlinked limits).
A changelog fragment that does not cite its paths.

items.title: Every must has a check
items.test: Can I find a `must`, `never`, `always` or `required` in a spec, ADR or rule that names no test, lint, gate or review step that verifies it?
items.verify: For each normative sentence in the diff, find the check named beside it or in the Test plan; unverifiable rules are downgraded to guidance or get a Linear issue.
items.falsePositives: Rules whose check is the reviewer itself, when the rubric item is cited.

items.title: Links resolve
items.test: Can I find a relative link, anchor, issue identifier or file path in the diff that does not exist or points at a moved file?
items.verify: Run the link checker on changed files; resolve every `PAP-<n>` against Linear and every path against the tree.
items.falsePositives: Links to artefacts created by the same PR's CI run, labelled as such.

items.title: ADR completeness
items.test: Does a new or changed ADR lack Status, Context, Decision, Consequences or Alternatives rejected, carry a number not in the pre-assigned list, or change a decision without superseding the old ADR?
items.verify: Compare against `docs/adr/template.md` (PAP-209, PAP-130); a superseded ADR gets `Status: Superseded by 00nn`.
items.falsePositives: Draft ADRs explicitly marked `Status: Proposed` with the missing section listed as open.

items.title: Changelog fragment and paths
items.test: Does a PR that lands user- or developer-visible change lack `docs/changelog/unreleased/PAP-<n>.md`, or does the fragment omit what landed, the paths and the ADR?
items.verify: Fragment exists, 2 to 6 lines, names the paths and the ADR number when one exists; `CHANGELOG.md` itself is not edited directly.

items.title: Spec declares states, access, events and edge cases
items.test: Can I find a page or app spec missing its States, Access, Events, Actions or Edge cases section, or declaring a component id not in the registry?
items.verify: `pnpm spec validate` output cited; each section present and non-empty or explicitly `n/a` with a reason.
items.falsePositives: Library and infrastructure specs where the schema marks the section optional.

items.title: Memory and knowledge provenance
items.test: Can I find a memory entry, domain rule or knowledge-base fact with no date, source and owner, or a change that overwrites an old rule instead of marking it superseded?
items.verify: Entries carry `since`, `source` and `owner`; superseded rules stay with `until` and a pointer (org standard: explicit change tracking so outdated rules are never mistaken for current ones).
items.falsePositives: Scratch notes under a clearly labelled `drafts/` path.

items.title: Generated files not hand-edited
items.test: Does the diff edit a generated file (`roster.json`, JSON Schemas, docs tables, compat matrix, rubric docs) directly instead of its source, or ship a source change without regenerating?
items.verify: Regenerate and diff (`pnpm build:schemas`, `pnpm build:docs`, drift tests); the generated header names the source.

items.title: Surfaces and abilities recorded
items.test: Does the PR add or change an MCP tool, CLI command, API route or WebMCP action without recording it in `docs/reference/surfaces.md` (and the actions registry for pages)?
items.verify: Diff the exported tools, routes and commands against the surfaces doc section for the issue.
items.falsePositives: Internal helpers not reachable from any surface.
